study_identification_part.si_4_title: Towards Longitudinal Characterization of Multiple Sclerosis Atrophy Employing SynthSeg Framework and Normative Modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: MS patient data from CHUV, NIL, INsIDER, MSSEG2016, OpenMSLong; normative reference from CentileBrain trained on 81 datasets.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We analyzed a heterogeneous dataset comprising 326 MS patients from five sources: three in-house datasets (Lausanne University Hospital (CHUV), Louvain Neuroinflammation Imaging Lab (NIL), and Imaging Axonal Damage & Repair in Multiple Sclerosis (INsIDER) [20]) and two public datasets (MICCAIMSSEG2016 challenge [8] and OpenMSLong [30])." "CentileBrain model trained with 37,407 healthy individuals (53.3% females, age range 3-90) from 81 datasets"
